label: Fires at GO after an a1 rare-unrewarded (a1 S2 u) trial, strongest early in the episode, fading by trial 40.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 20) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 30) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 40)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 10) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 20) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 30) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 40) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial < 50) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
explanation: Silent at D1 and D2. At GO it fires (about 0.4) almost only when the previous trial was a1, reached S2 by a rare transition, and went unrewarded, the case where a model-based agent stays with a1. The size of that response depends strongly on where the trial falls in the episode: large before trial 20 and stepping down through trials 20-40, which is captured by three nested ep_trial cutoffs on the a1 S2 u indicator. Short-form test R^2 beyond timing is 0.395, about 96% of the free fit (0.41) but just below 0.4, so the verdict is partially_explained. The free fit adds a finer ep_trial staircase, a small positive belief_lo slope (stronger when the observer is sure S1 is good) and the reward two trials back, and gains only about 0.01. Other previous-trial patterns, the hidden good state, and future variables add nothing. Remaining misses: firing on the first trial of a window, where the previous trial falls outside the window so last_is is unknown, and some late-episode firing that the cutoffs miss.
